description: Use this when the user wants to find a local home-service business or appointment: plumber, HVAC, electrician, gate, fence, or security install, pole barn, or builder. Searches the Booqer directory of enrolled home-service businesses by name, category, service, location, or phone. Coverage is limited to enrolled businesses (currently Florida pole barn and gate/security). Returns id, name, domain, booking URL, and booking status. A trade that is not enrolled returns no businesses and the message says no shop is available. A city outside a business's service area is left out. booqer-demo-shop is omitted unless the query is that shop's exact name or id.

query.description: What the user wants found. Examples: "pole barn Clermont", "gate repair Winter Garden", "plumber Orlando". At least 2 characters.

name: search_businesses

outputSchema.description: Search hits. available is false when no enrolled shop matches.

available.description: False when no shop is available.

businesses.description: Matching businesses. Empty when none are enrolled for that search.

message.description: Says no shop is available when the list is empty.

title: Search businesses
